summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — IFX.DE +6%, ANTO.L +6%, AAL.L +6%, STMPA.PA +6%, ASML.AS +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ENX.PA -5%, SHL.DE -3%, FME.DE -3%, CAP.PA -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: IFX.DE (+6.35%) — No confirmed same-day news found. Likely AI-power and semiconductor momentum, possibly tied to FY2026 Q4 results or outlook around now (stock up ~69% YTD). Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: IFX.DE is a large-cap German (Xetra) semiconductor and no strategy lists it. If results were the trigger, the gap-up came at the open, so post-open signals would be too late anyway.
